mechanism: Febuxostat may increase serum uric acid levels initially and both drugs can affect renal function; candesartan-induced vasodilation combined with febuxostat's potential effects on cardiovascular hemodynamics may increase risk of hypotension and reduced renal perfusion.
action: Monitor blood pressure and renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) periodically; ensure adequate hydration and assess for signs of hypotension or declining renal function during concurrent use.
